title: Z--NOTICE OF JUSTIFICATION AND APPROVAL
description: The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command, Europe Africa Central (NAVFAC EURAFCENT) intends to extend the ordering period for the Mini Multiple Award Construction Contract (Mini MACC) for an additional 12 months, from September 2, 2026, to September 1, 2027. This is a bridge action and does not increase the original $95 million contract ceiling. The extension will utilize the remaining contract capacity of approximately $44 million. Incumbent Contractors: Liberal Construction, LLC Consorzio Continental Socconsortile A R RocKs GMBH Kooheji Contractors Macro Vantage Levant DMCC Justification: The extension is required due to "unusual and compelling urgency" under the authority of 10 U.S.C. � 3204(a)(2). Critical Mission Impact: A lapse in construction services at NSA Bahrain, the forward headquarters of the U.S. Fifth Fleet, would result in an unacceptable inability to perform emergency repairs and would degrade U.S. national security during a period of heightened operational activity in the region. Procurement Delays: The procurement of a long-term, competitive follow-on contract has been severely impacted by unforeseen events and the reassignment of key personnel to support critical operational priorities ("Operation Epic Fury"). Impracticality of Alternatives: Awarding a new contract vehicle at this time would cause an unavoidable and mission-critical delay of several months due to security, legal, and logistical requirements in Bahrain. This bridge action is necessary to provide the time required to complete the full and open competition for the follow-on MACC without incurring a dangerous gap in critical construction services.

title: J063 Service and Software Updates to Security Access Control and Camera Systems Across Idaho/ Eastern Oregon VA Locations
description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. This is not a solicitation for bids, proposals, proposal abstracts, or quotations. The purpose of this Sources Sought Notice is to obtain information regarding the availability and capability of all qualified sources to perform a potential requirement. The responses received from interested contractors will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition method. The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 20, is conducting market research to identify potential sources which can provide the following services: Title: Service and Software Updates to Security Access Control and Camera Systems NAICS Code: 561621, Security Systems Services (except Locksmiths) Locations: varies across Idaho/ Eastern Oregon VA, see below Tasks: Overview: the Contractor shall monitor the CBOCs in Caldwell, Twin Falls, Mountain Home, and Boise VAMC Logistics Warehouse internal or external doors and motion alarms. This requirement include alarm monitoring and possible service calls to all locations, including the Boise VA Medical Center (see below). The contract will also include security cameras, PIV card readers, and software updates from the Contractor. Software updates improve performance, add features, and patch vulnerabilities, keeping systems secure and compliant. Contractor shall respond to calls for service to maintain, repair, and/or replace needed hardware and/or software to correct problems associated with the following: any/all burglar alarm systems, video operations components and systems, Lenel Alarm Monitoring system, Milestone CCTV Software and hardware, and the Roam Alert Patient Management System. If Contractor replaces a non-operational burglar alarm system, the Contractor shall assume monitoring of the new system immediately. Contractor shall be requested by an authorized employee of the BVAMC to inspect, repair, or replace all systems related to burglar alarm systems, Lenel Security system, Milestone video management system, and associated parts or systems controlled by these systems to include; card readers, cameras, software updates, motion sensors, door/window contacts, dialers, switches, wires, conduit, circuit boards, wired or wireless communication systems, and other miscellaneous parts or accessories needed to repair or replace broken parts or systems. In addition to repairing the current video and access control systems, the Contractor shall, at the request of authorized employee of BVAMC, install new hardware or software to expand the abilities of the video or access control systems. Contractor may be asked to provide parts to the Boise VA when VA employees will complete the installation of those parts. The Contractor can be asked to provide spare items that the VA needs to have in stock. The Contractor shall respond to emergency service calls to the following locations and timeframes: Boise VA Medical Center, 500 W. Fort Street, Boise, Idaho 83702 (2-hour response time) Caldwell CBOC, 713 Haystack Wy, Caldwell, ID 83605 (2-hour response time) Eastern Oregon CBOC, 635 Hwy 20 N Suite #4, Hines, OR 97738 (6-hour response time) Mountain Home CBOC, 815 North 6th East, Mountain Home, ID 83647 (3-hour response time) Salmon CBOC, 705 Lena Street, Salmon, ID 83467 (8-hour response time) Twin Falls CBOC, 260 2nd Ave East, Twin Falls, ID 83301 (4-hour response time) Twin Falls Annex, 450 Falls Ave, Suite 108, Twin Falls, ID 83301 (4-hour response time) Vet Center, 2424 Bank Drive, Boise, ID 83702 (2-hour response time) River Street Clinic, 1276 River Street #203, Boise, ID 83702 (2-hour response time) Veterans Cemetery, 1585 East Elm St (E 4150 N), Buhl, Idaho 83316 (4-hour response time) Contractor shall electronically send the available updates to the VA Police Physical Security Officer, or come to the VA and install them from portable media. Due to the importance of this service, VA requests a minimum of a 2-hour response time. Additional Market Research and Considerations: The current requirement involves existing LenelS2 OnGuard and Milestone Systems software and hardware. The VA is reviewing if brand name or equal entities can participate that offer a solution compatible with existing LenelS2 OnGuard and Milestone Systems software and hardware, as well as authorized to work on existing equipment. Current requirements state Contractor shall employ local individuals with the following minimum certifications: Milestone Certified Integration Engineer (MCIE) and LenelS2 OnGuard Certified Expert. The requirement also requires as needed expansions and repair of existing Level, Milestone and Roam Alert video and access control systems. Period of Performance: Estimate 2/1/2026 � 1/31/2027, plus Option Years 1-4. Potential candidates having the capabilities necessary to provide the above stated services are invited to respond to this Sources Sought Notice via e-mail to Danielle Carrico at Danielle.Carrico@va.gov no later than 10/28/2026 at 5PM PT. No telephone inquiries will be accepted. RESPONSES SHOULD INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION: Company name UEI # (sam.gov) Address of laundry processing facility Business size Point of contact name, phone number, and e-mail address Capability statement Brand Name or Brand Name of Equal Information to include specs, technical information GSA Federal Supply Schedule contract, if applicable Disclaimer and Important Notes: This Sources Sought Notice does not obligate the Government to award a contract or otherwise pay for the information provided in response. The Government reserves the right to use information provided by respondents for any purpose deemed necessary and legally appropriate. The Government will treat any information received as proprietary and will not share such information with other companies. Any organization responding to this Sources Sought Notice should ensure that its response is complete and sufficiently detailed to allow the Government to determine the organization's qualifications to perform the work. Respondents are advised that the Government is under no obligation to acknowledge receipt of the information received or provide feedback to respondents with respect to any information submitted. The Government may or may not issue a solicitation as a result of this announcement. There is no solicitation available at this time.

title: Belgium – Legal services – Marché public ayant pour objet les services juridiques relatifs au contentieux lié au recouvrement des redevances de stationnement de l’Agence du stationnement de la Région de Bruxelles-Capitale
description: Le présent marché est un marché public de services à prester « à la demande expresse » du Pouvoir adjudicateur dans le cadre du recouvrement des redevances forfaitaires de stationnement par les titulaires de plaques d’immatriculation belges, dues à l’Agence en vertu de l’ordonnance du 6 juillet 2022. Le présent marché concerne le contentieux judiciaire lié au recouvrement des redevances de stationnement restées impayées à l’échéance du second rappel, notamment, dans les hypothèses suivantes : - les conditions d’établissement de la contrainte ne sont pas réunies et l’Agence décide de poursuivre le recouvrement par la voie judiciaire (article 16, § 7 de l’ordonnance du 6 juillet 2022) ; l’adjudicataire devra établir la citation destinée à saisir le Tribunal compétent et prester l’ensemble des services nécessaires à l’obtention d’un jugement favorable à l’Agence permettant de récupérer le montant principal et ses accessoires en réduisant au maximum les coûts tant pour le redevable que pour l’Agence ; - un recours a été introduit par un redevable s’opposant à la contrainte établie, visée et signifiée par exploit d’huissier (article 16, § 7 de l’ordonnance du 6 juillet 2022) ; l’adjudicataire devra représenter l’Agence devant le Tribunal saisi par le redevable et prestera l’ensemble des services nécessaires à l’obtention d’un jugement favorable tout en réduisant au maximum les coûts tant pour le redevable que pour l’Agence ; Le pouvoir adjudicateur privilégie, à l’issue de la citation dans les dossiers contradictoires où le débiteur comparaît personnellement ou par l’intermédiaire de son conseil, le recours à la négociation en vue d’un accord amiable, dans le respect des normes applicables et avec pour objectif de limiter au maximum les frais mis à charge des débiteurs ; Le présent marché concerne plusieurs commandes effectuées par le pouvoir adjudicateur en fonction des besoins et suivant les dispositions du présent cahier des charges. Le présent marché ne confère pas d’exclusivité dans le chef des adjudicataires et ne garantit aucune quantité de commande. Le marché est divisé en trois lots suivant le lieu du domicile du redevable : Lot 1 - Recouvrement en Région de Bruxelles-Capitale ; Lot 2 - Recouvrement en Région wallonne ; Lot 3 - Recouvrement en Région flamande. Il est précisé qu’un soumissionnaire ne peut se voir attribuer qu’un seul lot. Si le soumissionnaire dépose une offre pour plus d’un lot – ce qu’il peut faire –, il indique l’ordre de préférence des lots qu’il souhaite se voir attribuer, s’il était l’attributaire potentiel de plusieurs lots. Aucune amélioration/rabais de l’offre ne peut être liée à l’obtention de plusieurs lots. Il se voit attribuer le lot selon l’ordre de préférence indiqué, pour autant qu’il soit l’offrant le plus intéressant pour ledit lot. Si deux offrants sont à égalité dans le cadre de la règle précitée, l’adjudicateur peut leur permettre d’améliorer leur offre de prix. La présente disposition est adoptée en exécution de l’article 58 § 2 de la loi du 17 juin 2016. Le pouvoir adjudicateur se réserve le droit de ne pas négocier.
